g.text: I am a 3rd semester Artificial Intelligence student passionate about solving
complex logic problems and building robust digital architecture. I believe the
best developers don’t just write code; they design systems that can make an impact.
My technical foundation is built on C++ and SQL, allowing me to understand the
deep mechanics of object-oriented programming and database management. I actively
leverage modern AI-assisted workflows for rapid prototyping, which allows me to
focus heavily on high-level system architecture, algorithmic design, and backend logic.
Beyond coursework, I am driven by practical application. Whether it is engineering
the backend for a smart transit system, designing comprehensive management software,
or organizing large-scale e-gaming events, I enjoy taking a project from the
initial blueprint to the final execution.
I am currently exploring new technologies and always open to connecting with fellow

text.tspan: tech enthusiasts, developers, and industry professionals.
